lines.t: Where does a law live before there is a world to obey it and if I reach the edge
of space would I reach the edge of anything
Yeah, yeah
Light on the ceiling turns oceans of blue
I'm lying awake while the walls fall through
Is distance a curtain, is time a door?
Would another dimension be creation still more?
The spirit of somewhere, or is somewhere too small
Can a creature leave matter and still meet a wall
Not brick, not iron, not measurable height
I limit that answer to somebody's right
I can picture a thousand impossible skies
It doesn't make knowledge of what's in my mind
Maybe my questions are sparks in the dark
The maps of the heavens, just signs of our heart
Hitherto shalt thou come
But no further
Was that only the sea, or am I hearing an echo of what it means to be creator?
A world that calls its hunger freedom. A king who cannot govern his own heart.
Did I hear that? Or did my conscience borrow stars to tell me what I wouldn't hear at home?
Watchers and angels, what do I know? Names on the page and the questions still grow.
Who kept their station? What banned in their place? What does rebellion look like face to face?
And demons, am I joining what the text leaves apart? Drawing whole family trees from a fragment of spark?
A mystery isn't permission to claim
Every shadow I picture is given its name
If a spirit deceives, must it force me to see?
Can it see what is holy and still choose to leave?
Not a rival creator, not another most high
Could a borrowed flame overthrow the sky?
The angels, which kept not their first estate
But left their own habitation
What if I cross?
Does crossing make you sovereign? No
A prisoner crossing a line
Has an abolished law
Not another throne, not another source
No created will makes the maker change course
Yahushua, Yahovah
Above the seen, the unseen
Whatever can crown itself over the king
The right is my mind, make a courtroom of space
And forget there is sorrow, beyond judgment's face
I imagine cold thunder and personal might
Then remember the wounded, remember denying
I'll reach for the pleasure of watching things break
What of the children, the hands that they take?
What of the crown and no palace that's true?
Would love still be love if it never said no?
For my wrath is born of sorrow
Says the Lord
And the deepest thing here
Isn't how far the heavens extend
It's that the one who could end my questioning
Would call a broken heart to mend
Why does the man keep looking upward?
Perhaps he thinks the answer must be far away
In flesh
Not escape from the body but flesh
The word
Entering hunger and weariness
The hands that could touch
The feet that could bleed
How does the infinite enter our need?
And the word was made flesh
And dwelt among us
Not a man
Who stole heaven by climbing a stair
Not Babel succeeding, not pride getting there
Yahuwah in flesh
My category's been to glorify men
Our creations ascend
What I cannot contain I will not cut down small
The risen one speaking of power over all
All power is given unto me
In heaven and in earth
Given and nothing left outside the reach of heaven
At the edge of my imagining
At the edge of who you are
I lay down my little kingdoms
Every child and borrowed star
Yahushua, Yahuwah
Horrified, the risen king
Heaven is not your rival
You reign over everything
Not my theory, not my vision
Not the dream that carried me
Yours the throne beyond my knowing
Yours the last authority
The ceiling's just a ceiling, the morning finds my face
I still don't know the shape of heaven, but I know I cannot take your place
Yahoo, yahoo, yahoo
Yahushua, Yahuwah
